note: Measured baseline for fixtures/performance, not a product target. Update with `node scripts/performance-budget.ts --update` and explain in the pull request what grew and why. gzip is level 9 per asset; count is the stylesheets, modules, inline scripts, or font files the route loads. A font counts once per route whichever stylesheet or face declares it, so the font/self-hosted assets list the file, its URL, and the @font-face behind the totals.
